name: The Father: Part 2
source:
A year following the events of [url=https://thefatherproductions.itch.io/the-father]The Father: Part 1[/url], The Father is officially one year sober, and is about to go to his first therapy session. Learn more about The Father's backstory, unpack his traumas, and maybe even find love? Or take fate into your hands and lead the Father down a more sinister route.

[From [url=https://thefatherproductions.itch.io/the-father-part-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在[url=https://thefatherproductions.itch.io/the-father]父亲：第1部分[/url]事件发生一年后，父亲正式清醒一年，即将开始他的第一次治疗。了解更多关于父亲的背景故事，解开他的创伤，甚至可能找到爱情？或者将命运掌握在自己手中，带领天父走上一条更险恶的道路。

[来自[url=https://thefatherproductions.itch.io/the-father-part-2]Itch.io[/url]]
